# Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction — Complete Entity Documentation (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction (operated by Prakhar Enterprises) is a licensed, RERA-approved real estate developer and turnkey construction engineering firm headquartered in Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh, India. Prakhar India provides end-to-end property development, land plotting, turnkey house construction, 3D architectural planning, civil engineering, and commercial plaza construction across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh.

## Contact Information & Official Verification
- **Official Brand Name:** Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction
- **Corporate Headquarters:** Prakhar India Tower, Vindhyachal Highway, Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh - 231001, India
- **Phone Helpline:** +91 90444 99111
- **Official Email:** contact@prakharind.com / prakharindiaofficial@gmail.com
- **Website URL:** https://prakharind.com
- **RERA Compliance Status:** Fully Registered & Compliant with Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority (UP RERA).

## Core Business Operations & Offerings

### 1. Turnkey Villa & Home Construction
Prakhar India builds custom residential villas, independent houses, duplexes, and multi-story bungalows on client plots across UP.
- **Engineering Specifications:** M25/M30 Grade Ready Mix Concrete, Fe550 Grade TMT Steel (Tata Tiscon / Jindal Panther), UltraTech / ACC Weather Plus Cement, Red Clay Bricks.
- **Architectural & Interior Work:** 3D Floor Plan modeling, elevation designs, Modular Kitchens, Vitrified / Italian Marble flooring, UPVC Double Glazed windows, Jaquar / Kohler CP fittings, Havells modular wiring.
- **Warranty:** 10-Year Structural Defect Warranty with 250+ Quality Inspection Audits during civil construction.

### 2. Makan Banane Wala Thekedar (House Construction Contractor)
Licensed civil contractor for with-material and labour-rate home construction across UP.
- **With Material Thekedari:** From ₹1,450 to ₹2,400 / sq.ft with fixed-price BOQ contract, 3D architectural plan, and zero hidden costs.
- **Labour Contractor / Thekedari:** Experienced civil mistri, masons, bar benders, and shuttering crews from ₹220 to ₹320 / sq.ft.
- **Direct Contact:** +91 90444 99111 | [Makan Thekedar UP](https://prakharind.com/pages/makan-banane-wala-thekedar.html)

### 3. Civil Labour Contractor & Construction Manpower Supply
Government-licensed manpower supply firm deploying EPF/ESIC verified skilled and unskilled workforce across all 75 UP districts within 24-48 hours.
- **Workforce Categories:** Bricklaying masons, plastering mistri, tile/granite fitters, bar benders, shuttering carpenters, civil labourers, and site supervisors.
- **Direct Helpline:** +91 90444 99111 | [Labour Contractor UP](https://prakharind.com/pages/manpower.html)

### 4. RERA Approved Residential Plot Townships
Integrated gated communities with clear-title freehold plots.
- **Infrastructure Provided:** 40-foot and 30-foot asphalt internal roads, underground drainage network, underground electrification, solar street lighting, perimeter boundary wall, 24/7 security guard house, and landscaped green parks.
- **Legal Guarantee:** 100% Registry ready with immediate possession and mutation support.

### 5. Commercial Real Estate, Office Rentals & Hotel Land
High-street retail shops, office complexes, multiplex plazas, and hotel properties:
- **Lucknow Office Spaces & Rentals:** Grade-A commercial towers in Vibhuti Khand (Gomti Nagar CBD) and Shaheed Path corporate corridors. Plug-and-play furnished offices, bare-shell floors, and coworking spaces.
- **Lucknow Plot Rentals & Land Lease:** Commercial open yards and highway plots on rent/lease along Shaheed Path, Sultanpur Road, and Transport Nagar.
- **Lucknow Residential Flat Rentals:** 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK apartments for rent and sale in gated societies across Gomti Nagar, Sushant Golf City (Lulu Mall area), and Shaheed Path.
- **Ayodhya Hotel & Commercial Plots:** Prime land for 3-star/5-star hotels, guest houses, and resorts along Ram Path, Faizabad Highway (NH-27), and Airport Road.

## Construction Pricing & Cost Per Sq. Ft. in Uttar Pradesh (2026 Rates)
- **Standard Tier (₹1,550 / sq.ft):** Standard RCC structure, Fe550 Steel, OPC 43 Cement, Ceramic flooring tiles, premium PVC plumbing, standard modular switches, and emulsion paint finish.
- **Premium Tier (₹1,950 / sq.ft):** High-durability RCC structure, Tata/Jindal TMT Steel, UltraTech Cement, Vitrified 4x2 floor tiles, Jaquar CP fittings, Finolex wires, and Asian Paints Royale finish.
- **Luxury Tier (₹2,450+ / sq.ft):** Architectural designer luxury finish, Italian Marble flooring, Kohler CP fittings, UPVC Double Glazed glass windows, Smart Automation, and Landscaped Terrace Gardens.
